error.notInServer: Setup must be run in a server.

step1.title: Step 1 of 8 — Language
step1.description: Choose your server's language. This affects bot responses and logs.

step2.title: Step 2 of 8 — Server type
step2.description: Choose a preset that matches your community. Each preset applies recommended strictness, modules, and extra settings.

step3.title: Step 3 of 8 — Server size
step3.description: Auto-detected tier: {autoDetected} ({memberCount} members). Adjust if needed.

step4.title: Step 4 of 8 — Strictness
step4.description: Choose how strictly the bot should enforce rules. This affects AutoMod, anti-raid, and penalties.

step5.title: Step 5 of 8 — Staff roles
step5.description: Choose which roles can use moderation commands. You can select up to 10 roles per level.

step6.title: Step 6 of 8 — Channels
step6.description: Choose a mod-log channel and welcome channel. Or let the bot create them for you.

step7.title: Step 7 of 8 — Features
step7.description: Toggle the modules you want to enable. You can change these later in /settings.

step8.title: Step 8 of 8 — Preview
step8.description: Review your choices before applying. Changes are written in a single transaction and recorded in /settings history.

complete.title: Setup complete!
complete.description: Your server is now configured. You can adjust any setting anytime with /settings.

cancel.title: Setup cancelled
cancel.description: Setup was cancelled. Run /setup again to resume.
